## Wave 6 Summary

The S99 flat-band literature sweep (G7; landau + berry paired reports) found that the 2024–2026 quantum-geometry laboratory literature independently converges on the exact algebraic specification of the framework's FIRST registered cross-pillar bridge, **§VII.AF.1.OP-PROJ** (Pillar III HP¹ cohomology ↔ Pillar IV Peotta–Törmä quantum-metric trace; LANDED S87 W5-1; suffix-retrofit S88 W11 V.4). This wave converts three of that sweep's convergent carry-forwards into pre-registered computation gates:

1. **§W6-1 (item 14)** — direct projector-side confirmation that the bridge integrand is built from the **BdG/quasihole-state projector** `P_0(τ_fold)` (Porlles–Chen, arXiv:2505.17349): the BdG choice must reproduce the PRIMARY canonical pairing anchor and the normal-state (τ=0) choice must NOT — demonstrating the projector choice is load-bearing. This is an **Element-5 STRUCTURAL CONFIRMATION of the EXISTING §VII.AF.1.OP-PROJ entry**, NOT a new bridge registration (no new 5-anatomy block; the existing entry's anatomy and three-level ladder are cited per `cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md §"Registry-PASS criterion — Level-3 annotation discipline"`).
2. **§W6-2 (item 15)** — non-Abelian `Tr[R_μν]` over the degenerate lowest multiplet of `D_K` on the (τ,μ) U(2)-invariant TT surface (Chen–Karki–Hosur, arXiv:2501.16965): verify `Tr R ≠ Σ(per-band Abelian QM)` — the algebra-correct object for `A_K = ℂ ⊕ ℍ ⊕ M₃(ℂ)` — and re-confirm the imaginary part integrates to Chern = 0 (metric-not-curvature). Also an Element-5/structural confirmation of the existing entry, not a new registration.
3. **§W6-3 (item 16)** — extract the MgB₂ Leggett-mode frequency-to-gap ratio and damping from the on-disk Yuan PDF (arXiv 2412.13830; index entry marked [INCOMPLETE] — PDF-extraction honesty applies), propagate the damping universality class through the **χ inheritance morphism** `χ : ℂ ⊕ ℍ ⊕ M₃(ℂ) → M₂(ℂ)` (M₃(ℂ) → 0; ker χ = M₃(ℂ); `inheritance-falsifier-protocol.md` canonical realization + `3HeB-inheritance-canonical.md`), and bound the substrate DM inter-band-coherence decay channel — expressed STRICTLY in the canonical CONDITIONAL ratio/inequality form (`Γ_grav < H_0`; survival margin `τ_DM/t_univ = 1.13e65`, gate LEGGETT-GRAV-DECAY-73a).

**Wave-6 SLOT LAW (binding for every block in this wave; consolidation §III.E)**: the `R_geom = ∫_BZ Tr g_ab^{(P_0)}` bridge is **§VII.AF.1.OP-PROJ** (anchored: s86-hp1 workshop, `sessions/archive/session-86/workshops/s86-hp1-cohomology-quantum-metric-bridge.md`); **§VII.W is the HP parity-grading orthogonality theorem** — a DIFFERENT theorem (Pillar III internal cohomology). The S99 litrev index conflated the two; the gate IDs in this wave carry the corrected slot. The bridge object is the quantum **METRIC** (Re QGT) — the framework's Berry CURVATURE vanishes identically on SU(3) (Im QGT = 0, max|Ω| < 4e-14, 12 zero invariants; S25/S61, off-Jensen-confirmed S96-GEOM-OFFJENSEN-CHERN); any reading importing a Chern/curvature contribution lands on a structurally-zero quantity (Chen–Karki–Hosur regime: metrically rich, topologically trivial — `Tr R ≠ 0` while Chern = 0).

**Wave-6 CANONICAL-FORM LAW for item 16 (MANDATORY)**: the "τ_DM = 4.93e82 s" absolute-seconds figure is UNCANONICAL — the canonical survival condition is the qualitative inequality `Γ_grav < H_0` with survival-margin RATIO `τ_DM/t_univ = 1.13e65` (LEGGETT-GRAV-DECAY-73a) and `Γ_grav/H_0 ≈ 8.85e-66` (S95 LEGGETT-GRAV-DECAY-CONDITIONAL, Row #68). ## §W6-1. S100b-VII-AF1-BDG-PROJECTOR-CONFIRM

**Slot law (cited per wave law)**: this gate confirms the integrand of the **§VII.AF.1.OP-PROJ** bridge (NOT §VII.W, which is HP parity-grading orthogonality). It is an **Element-5 STRUCTURAL CONFIRMATION of the existing entry** — the existing entry's IS-not-IN anatomy (5 elements, registry lines 14952–14958) and three-level ladder (Level 1 cohomology-class identity / Level 2 `L^{-3}` envelope at d=4 / Level 3 empirical anchor 0.0095% F₄ strict at L_max=10) are CITED, not re-registered. Per `cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md §"Registry-PASS criterion — Level-3 annotation discipline"`, the registered entry's PASS is governed solely by the central-value criterion (`r = 19/200 = 0.0950` Sage-exact, Level-3 < Level-2); this gate adds a projector-discrimination confirmation at the anchor's PRIMARY-canonical source layer and cannot retro-modify the registered verdict.

**Anchor-conflation guard (registry CF-26 S90 W2 annotation, MANDATORY)**: the Level-3 anchor of §VII.AF.1.OP-PROJ involves three STRUCTURALLY DISTINCT derived scalars that this gate MUST NOT conflate — (1) anchor ratio `r = 19/200 = 0.0950` (match/envelope); (2) `STRICT_F4 = 1.030902` (= `R_universal_HP1_strict_F4`, Class-(d) DERIVATIVE of the PRIMARY; `= 1/f_4_prefactor_sdw` to publication precision); (3) `err_STRICT = 0.0095%`. The PRIMARY canonical is `eps_H_HP1_norm = 16.197719` at the ζ-regulator (`R_universal = eps_H_HP1_norm × f_4_prefactor_zeta`, with `f_4^ζ = 1`; W-5 V4 Step 1 + `session-90-plan-w5.md` substitution chain). The F₄ atlas ratios (2)–(3) CANCEL `R_universal` by construction (they are pure `f_4^r` prefactor ratios — see `s85_w5_6_eps_h_hp1_scan.py:19-30`), so a projector swap is INVISIBLE at the atlas-ratio layer. **This gate therefore operates at the PRIMARY pairing layer**: it evaluates the Connes–Karoubi pairing directly from the projector side and compares against `eps_H_HP1_norm` — exactly the numerical projector-side evaluation the s86-hp1 workshop's V4 question queued ("a numerical computation … on the L_max=10 spectrum to verify that its value reproduces the W5-6 value").

**Reading-A/Reading-B conflation guard**: the gate anchors to the PRIMARY ζ-regulator canonical (`eps_H_HP1_norm`), NOT to Reading A (`R_universal_HP1_strict_F4 = 1.030902`, SCHEMATIC SDW canonical) and NOT to Reading B (`ρ_FULL(s=3, L_max=12) = 1.0100907902`, FULL CC canonical). The projector discrimination is performed at fixed evaluator pipeline (ζ pairing); the SCHEMATIC-vs-FULL level-pin axis is orthogonal to the projector-choice axis and is not touched.

## §W6-2. S100b-NONABELIAN-METRIC-FRACTION

**Slot law (cited per wave law)**: this gate is a STRUCTURAL CONFIRMATION on the **§VII.AF.1.OP-PROJ** bridge object (NOT §VII.W). The bridge object is the quantum METRIC (Re QGT); the framework's Berry CURVATURE vanishes identically on SU(3) (Im QGT = 0, max|Ω| < 4e-14, 12 zero invariants; S25/S61/S96). The Chen–Karki–Hosur regime — `Tr R ≠ 0` while Chern = 0, metrically rich and topologically trivial — IS the substrate's regime; this gate verifies the substrate realizes it on its own degenerate fiber: `Tr R ≠ Σ(per-band Abelian QM)` (the algebra-correct object for `A_K = ℂ ⊕ ℍ ⊕ M₃(ℂ)`) with the Im part integrating to Chern = 0. NOT a new bridge registration; no new 5-anatomy block.

    PRIMARY arm: the lowest-|lambda| degenerate multiplet (expected deg = 2, the

    (tau, mu) = (0.19, 0) vs the s84 L12 spectrum cache (builder-drift guard).

substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Step 1 (Definitions):
      M(tau,mu)      = lowest-|lambda| degenerate multiplet of D_K(tau,mu), (0,0) sector  [S96 lowest_band_multiplet, deg_tol = 1e-7]
      P_M            = Sum_{n in M} |u_n><u_n|                                            [multiplet projector]

      g^{(n)}_ab     = Re <d_a u_n | (1 - |u_n><u_n|) | d_b u_n>                           [per-band Abelian metric, fixed eigh gauge]
    Step 2 (Substitute — expand the Abelian complement against the multiplet complement):
      (1 - |u_n><u_n|) = (1 - P_M) + Sum_{m in M, m != n} |u_m><u_m|
      => g^{(n)}_ab = Re Q^{nn}_{ab} + Sum_{m != n in M} Re <d_a u_n|u_m><u_m|d_b u_n>
    Step 3 (Simplify — one step per line):

      I_Ab >= I_NA on the diagonal-integrated trace (the cross-terms are positive
      semidefinite at a = b) => f_nonAb = (I_Ab - I_NA)/I_NA >= 0, with f_nonAb > 0

      Chen-Karki-Hosur non-additivity Tr R != Sum(per-band Abelian QM), realized

      is structurally zero on SU(3) (12 zero invariants) => |Im_int| < 1e-12 and
      C_FHS quantized to 0 expected.

      non-Abelian object is structurally distinct from the Abelian sum on the
      substrate fiber, while the topology stays trivial (metric-not-curvature).
